_help: Predefined circuitikz components. Use these exact forms; do not invent symbols. Edit to change style or add parts.

resistor.note: Label with a symbol, or a value like $10\,\mathrm{k}\Omega$

diode.note: Current flows anode to cathode, left to right

dc_source.note: Use battery1 for a battery symbol

npn.note: Anchors: Q.B base, Q.C collector, Q.E emitter

nmos.note: Anchors: M.G gate, M.D drain, M.S source

opamp.note: Anchors: A.- (upper input), A.+ (lower input), A.out. Do not flip unless the circuit needs it.

and_gate.note: Anchors: G.in 1, G.in 2, G.out. Same pattern for or, nand, nor, xor, not ports.

junction.note: Filled dot where wires connect. Crossing wires without a dot are NOT connected.

terminal.note: Open circle for an external terminal (Vin, Vout)

layout_rules: Place by relative offsets (++(2,0)) or named anchors, not scattered absolute coordinates.
Label every component with a symbol or a value.
Mark Vin and Vout with terminals.
Signal flows left to right, supply on top, ground at the bottom.
